prompt:
Use case: text-localization / precise-object-edit.
Asset: one existing hand-drawn presentation slide. EDIT ONLY Image 1.

Input roles:
Image 1 = EDIT TARGET, slide 16 "分析完 Log，還要交付正式報告".
Image 2 = MAIN REFERENCE for TEXT OPTICAL STROKE WEIGHT ONLY, adjacent slide 17.
Image 3 = SECONDARY TEXT WEIGHT REFERENCE, adjacent slide 15.
Do not copy any wording, icon, composition, or content from images 2 or 3.

Requested change: Image 1 lettering is too thin and monoline compared with both adjacent slides. Adjust ONLY text stroke fullness to match the medium-weight natural handwritten pen lettering of Image 2, with Image 3 as a cross-check. Match optical weight relative to character height, not a blanket percentage increase.
- Keep the exact existing character shapes, font size, character height, text bounding boxes, baselines, placement, spacing and line breaks of Image 1.
- Main title and navy labels should have fuller natural strokes, subtle pressure variation and tapered pen starts/ends, as in reference 2.
- Coral-red annotations must use the same medium optical text weight as the navy labels at comparable character height. Keep their coral color and exact placement. Do not make them brush calligraphy or thick marker blocks.
- Preserve open counters and legibility. No uniform morphological dilation, printed bold font, outline text, heavy brush calligraphy, or extra bold blocks.
- Pen texture should be confidently handwritten and slightly irregular, not clean digital typography.

Exact text must remain VERBATIM:
Title: "分析完 Log，還要交付正式報告"
Left label: "分析結果"
Center label: "LLM 自由撰寫"
Right label: "產生報告"
Inside right report icon: "正式報告"
Coral annotations: "格式可能不一致" and "分類可能遺漏"

STRICT INVARIANTS:
Change only lettering stroke fullness. Preserve ALL icons, icon outlines, report-document drawings, magnifying glass, speech bubble, pen, arrows, hatching, underline, coral bracket and accent strokes, cream paper, faint grid, background, blank space, colors, layout and canvas framing of Image 1. Do not thicken illustration outlines. Do not resize or move text. No added/deleted words, no page number, no chapter badge, no border, no watermark, no new objects. Return a single standalone landscape slide, same 16:9 aspect ratio, at highest available native clarity.
